validate automated alerts to confirm whether they are genuine incidents requiring action

collect detailed information from customers to accurately identify the nature and scope of service requests or incidents.
evaluate system alerts and customer inputs to classify incidents appropriately.
assess and implement the most suitable solutions or workarounds for the reported issues
follow the organization's guidelines, utilize standard scripts, and leverage Generative AI tools to resolve incidents efficiently.

identify and mitigate cybersecurity threats such as phishing attacks and social engineering attempts to safeguard user systems and data

collaborate with peers, technical teams, or managers to seek assistance when required.

actively listen to customers to fully understand their concerns and ensure a customer- centric resolution.
confirm with customers that their issues have been resolved to their satisfaction before closing the request
document the resolution process and outcomes for each incident or service request.
ensure adherence to relevant organizational standards, policies, procedures, and service-level agreements (SLAs) when managing incidents or requests.
apply the fundamentals of Generative AI tools to enhance IT help desk operations and service delivery.
